# MoneyTag: Income & Expense

> A project-based income and expense tracker for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
> Each project is its own ledger with its own base currency and its own
> income − expenses = net result. Tags are first-class and can be totalled
> across every project. Projects, transactions, tags and settings stay on the
> device; there are no accounts, ads, analytics, tracking or third-party SDKs.

## Facts
- Free: 1 project and 10 transactions, no time limit, no ads.
- Lifetime Pro: one-time purchase, never a subscription. Unlocks unlimited
  projects and transactions, cross-project tag analysis, custom categories and
  tags, CSV and PDF export, backup and restore.
- On the Home screen, choose an input currency and use public automatic rates
  refreshed about every 6 hours, set a manual rate, or reset to automatic.
  Converted amounts are saved in the project's base currency. Saved rates work
  offline.
- The only non-Apple network use is fetching public exchange-rate quotes from
  services that require no API key: primary `open.er-api.com`, fallback
  `api.frankfurter.app`. No transaction, project, tag, setting or personal data
  is sent.
- Apple Watch app and Home Screen / Lock Screen widgets, both reading on-device
  data only.
- Purchases and restores are handled entirely by Apple.
- Contact: hourstag.app@gmail.com

## 繁體中文
- MoneyTag 是以專案為單位的雙向收支損益工具；每個專案都有自己的基準幣別，並計算收入 − 支出 = 淨額。
- 首頁可直接選擇輸入幣別，使用約每 6 小時更新的公開自動匯率，也可設定手動匯率或還原為自動。
  換算後以專案基準幣別儲存，已儲存的匯率離線時仍可使用。
- 專案、交易、標籤與設定只留在裝置上；沒有帳號、廣告、分析、追蹤或第三方 SDK。
- 唯一非 Apple 的網路用途是向免 API 金鑰的公開匯率服務取得報價：主要服務為
  `open.er-api.com`，失敗時改用 `api.frankfurter.app`。不會傳送交易、專案、標籤、
  設定或任何個人資料。
- App 內購買與還原由 Apple 處理。
